entities.summary: Markelle N'Gai Fultz is an American professional basketball player for the Toronto Raptors of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Washington Huskies before being selected by the Philadelphia 76ers with the first overall pick in the 2017 NBA draft.
